title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Credit Policy Note — The Late-Charge Count Window for Credit Line Increases
content:
The late-charge count window is the span, in whole calendar months counted back from the decision date, over which late payment charges on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account are counted for a credit line increase. It is set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards service level and the account's age:

| Condition | Late-charge count window |
|---|---|
| The business's ProBuild membership carries a dedicated pro account representative and the account has been open at least 60 whole months | 6 months (short window) |
| The account has been open at least 24 whole months, and the first condition is not met | 9 months (established-account window) |
| Every other case | The tier's clean-history months: 12 months on every Ridgeline Pro Credit tier |

## Reading the conditions

- Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the decision date.
- The membership is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status. The dedicated pro account representative is a benefit of the ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite tiers; the ProBuild Member, Bronze and Silver tiers carry none.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Membership | Account age | Window |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Gold | 60 whole months | 6 months |
| ProBuild Gold | 59 whole months | 9 months |
| ProBuild Silver | 70 whole months | 9 months |
| No membership | 24 whole months | 9 months |
| ProBuild Platinum | 23 whole months | 12 months |
